gloss: on the way, in the middle

definitions.explanation: While traveling from one place to another.
During the course of an activity or process, before completion.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}までの{途中|とちゅう}でコンビニに{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped by a convenience store on the way to the station.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{途中|とちゅう}で{寝|ね}てしまった。
examples.english: I fell asleep in the middle of the movie.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{途中|とちゅう}ですが、{少|すこ}し{休憩|きゅうけい}しましょう。
examples.english: We're in the middle of work, but let's take a short break.

examples.japanese: {通勤|つうきん}の{途中|とちゅう}で{事故|じこ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw an accident on my way to work.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}の{途中|とちゅう}で{電話|でんわ}が{切|き}れてしまった。
examples.english: The call got disconnected in the middle of our conversation.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}への{途中|とちゅう}で{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: It started raining on the way to school.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{途中|とちゅう}で{諦|あきら}めた。
examples.english: I gave up in the middle of the exam.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}りの{途中|とちゅう}でスーパーに{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped by the supermarket on my way home.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}んでいる{途中|とちゅう}で{眠|ねむ}くなった。
{旅行|りょこう}の{途中|とちゅう}で{財布|さいふ}を{落|おと}とした。
examples.english: I dropped my wallet on the trip.

notes:
{途中|とちゅう} indicates being partway through something (travel or activity).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{途中|とちゅう}で: in the middle of ~, on the way to ~
- {途中|とちゅう}から: from partway through
- {途中|とちゅう}まで: up to a certain point
- {途中|とちゅう}下車|げしゃ}: stopping off (during a journey)

EXAMPLES BY CONTEXT:
- {通勤|つうきん}の{途中|とちゅう}: on the way to work
- {話|はなし}の{途中|とちゅう}: in the middle of talking
- {途中|とちゅう}で{やめる|やめる}: to quit partway through
